# QR Code encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified ES module build of Kazuhiko Arase's
`qrcode-generator`, licensed under the MIT licence included in
`qrcode-LICENSE.txt`.

The upstream `.mjs` filename is changed to `.js` so the demo's static server
serves it with a JavaScript MIME type. Its contents are unchanged.

- Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Pinned commit: `83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`
- Source file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8/js/dist/qrcode.mjs
- Licence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8/LICENSE
- Retrieved: 2026-09-16

The demo generates the QR locally; it makes no requests to a remote QR service.
